rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Popolo thought there was nothing left
to learn about Chairman Morumo, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0002
rows.name:
But I was wrong, mo. To think the
chairman was so...

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Popular with older ladies, mo! I had
no idea, mo!!

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Makumaku-san gives the chairman such
intense looks, mo. And he notices
Makumaku-san too, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Ahh... It's not fair that the chairman
gets all the attention, mo. Why does
Popolo have no romance at all, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Popolo wants to be popular too, mo,
and be showered in blazing-hot looks,
mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0007
rows.name:
Sorry, mo. I must have been spacing
out, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_05_msg0008
rows.name:
Oh, right. It's strange, mo. The
chairman's fur seems to be falling out
again lately, mo.
